item.title: Notify NYC - Road Reopened - Gowanus Expressway (BK)
item.description:
Notification issued 11-03-2026 at 08:12 PM.
Following a prior closure, all lanes of the Gowanus Expressway have reopened at 86th Street in Brooklyn. Expect residual delays.

item.title: Notify NYC - Unplanned Road Closure - Gowanus Expressway (BK)
item.description:
Notification issued 11-03-2026 at 07:19 PM.
Due to a vehicle collision, all westbound lanes of the Gowanus Expressway are closed at 86th Street in Brooklyn. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
